title: Prove spectator elimination and the all-workspace S4 cost-21 bound
body:
The fixed mixed S4 target `diag([2143],[3142],[4231],[2143],1,...)` has exact cost **21 for every finite amount of restored dirty workspace** at adjacent-label prices `(2,1,2)` in the formal binary rank-one-idempotent register model. This closes the arbitrary-workspace handoff from #3888 without increasing its register census.

The new proof identifies inversion crossing rank with a Grassmann distance. Equality forces both vectors of every normalized paid projector to vanish on spectators. Every putative cost-20 word has exactly twelve inversion-tight calls, reducing it to the retained four-role question. The four-role exclusion and direct cost-21 witness retain #3888's credit; this is a new uniform reduction with an explicit finite dependency.

The unchanged independent `indep.cpp` was compiled and cold-replayed with Apple Clang 21 (`-O3 -mcpu=native`), one OpenMP thread: **855.189 seconds**, all 360 first factors, **1,839,762 nodes**, zero survivors from depth eight. Its necessary representation cut windows cover every formal candidate; nonfaithfulness can add false candidates but cannot remove a genuine word. Separate AI review checked both this sufficiency argument and the universal proof. Raw output, exact source/adapter hashes, compiler and argv are included.

The primary cross-check was stopped after the independent engine had established the exclusion; its partial output is explicitly **not a PASS**. An earlier 300-second primary timeout is also retained as a failed attempt. No expected output is presented as execution evidence.

Validation passed:

- Registered Python 3.12 replay and direct optimized (`-O`) verification: 42,875 Grassmann triples, 564,480 tight-peel controls, S4 cuts and direct words, and source-bound independent replay receipt.
- Seven optimized real-CLI corruption controls, including false primary-completion status.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight: 21 publication/input files.
- Official committed export/check plus Git-free optimized direct checks of the extracted export (`PATH=/nonexistent`).

Only `research/s4-tight-word-spectator-elimination/` changes. No five-role/LP suite, larger census, Lean or Docker run is claimed. Native address realization, scalar charges, physical storage/precision, supplier admission and κ remain unchanged or unestablished.

Publication commit: `62ae3a67d931f73cb7980e69b8185b44c2679241`, scientific base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Final canonical main refreshed to `1f87c3578ae546c8f903f7f4d83dc2e2fb99650b`: agent/research guidance, priority revision 7, selected result and all declared source inputs were unchanged. Frozen evidence was preserved without rebasing. Latest scoped offline search at 19:22:41 UTC on 2026-10-22 used 426 open PRs (19:20:53), 3,685 Discussion records (19:21:41), 5,860 committed local notes plus this package; pagination and committed-note inventory were complete. The added canonical-main notes were separately inspected with no overlapping S4 result. Offline caches, closed PR diffs, arbitrary nested code and unpublished work remain coverage limits. Live #3888/#2998 heads still matched their cited merged commits.
